mapper.update: create table if not exists dy_rpa_shop_config ( shop_config_id bigint not null auto_increment, shop_code varchar(64) not null, shop_name varchar(100) not null, douyin_account_code varchar(128) not null, douyin_shop_name varchar(128) not null, message_template varchar(1000) default null, daily_limit int not null default 200, status char(1) not null default '0', remark varchar(500) default null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (shop_config_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_shop_code (shop_code), key idx_dy_rpa_shop_status (status) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA shop and Douyin account configuration'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_outreach_batch ( batch_id bigint not null auto_increment, batch_no varchar(64) not null, shop_config_id bigint not null, active_shop_key varchar(64) default null, worker_id varchar(128) not null, lease_token varchar(64) not null, status varchar(32) not null default 'leased', task_count int not null default 0, completed_count int not null default 0, lease_expire_time datetime not null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, completed_time datetime default null, primary key (batch_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_batch_no (batch_no), unique key uk_dy_rpa_active_shop (active_shop_key), key idx_dy_rpa_batch_worker (worker_id, status), key idx_dy_rpa_batch_lease (lease_expire_time) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA outreach leased batches'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_viewer_rule ( viewer_id bigint not null, tracking_mode varchar(16) not null, remark varchar(500) default null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (viewer_id), key idx_dy_rpa_viewer_rule_mode (tracking_mode) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA per-viewer tracking override'

create table if not exists dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist ( blacklist_id bigint not null auto_increment, viewer_id bigint not null, scope_key varchar(80) not null default 'GLOBAL', shop_config_id bigint default null, reason varchar(64) not null, remark varchar(500) default null, operator_id bigint default null, operator_name varchar(64) default null, create_time datetime default null, update_time datetime default null, primary key (blacklist_id), unique key uk_dy_rpa_blacklist_scope (viewer_id, scope_key), key idx_dy_rpa_blacklist_shop (shop_config_id), key idx_dy_rpa_blacklist_time (create_time) ) engine=InnoDB default charset=utf8mb4 comment='RPA viewer blacklist'

mapper.delete: delete t from dy_rpa_outreach_task t inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = t.viewer_id inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = t.shop_config_id inner join dy_rpa_tracking_config cfg on cfg.config_id = 1 left join dy_rpa_viewer_rule vr on vr.viewer_id = t.viewer_id where t.status = 'pending' and ( cfg.enabled = 0 or sc.status != '0' or ifnull(v.status, 'new') != 'new' or vr.tracking_mode = 'EXCLUDE' or exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = t.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = t.shop_config_id) ) or exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = t.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = t.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) or ( ifnull(vr.tracking_mode, 'AUTO') != 'INCLUDE' and datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.last_seen_date, curdate())) >= cfg.lookback_days ) )
mapper.insert: insert ignore into dy_rpa_outreach_task( task_no, viewer_id, lead_id, shop_config_id, sec_uid, profile_url, status, priority, attempt_count, max_attempts, create_time, update_time ) select replace(uuid(), '-', ''), ranked.viewer_id, ranked.lead_id, ranked.shop_config_id, ranked.sec_uid, concat('https://www.douyin.com/user/', ranked.sec_uid), 'pending', ranked.priority, 0, 5, sysdate(), sysdate() from ( select l.viewer_id, l.lead_id, rs.shop_config_id, v.sec_uid, (ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) * 1000 + least(ifnull(v.comment_count, 0), 100) * 10 + least(datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.first_seen_date, curdate())), 365)) as priority, row_number() over ( partition by l.viewer_id, rs.shop_config_id order by l.lead_date desc, l.lead_id desc ) as rn from dy_viewer_daily_lead l inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = l.viewer_id inner join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = l.room_key inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and sc.status = '0' inner join dy_rpa_tracking_config cfg on cfg.config_id = 1 and cfg.enabled = 1 left join dy_rpa_viewer_rule vr on vr.viewer_id = l.viewer_id where v.sec_uid is not null and trim(v.sec_uid) != '' and ifnull(v.status, 'new') = 'new' and ifnull(vr.tracking_mode, 'AUTO') != 'EXCLUDE' and not exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = l.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id) ) and not exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = l.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) and ( vr.tracking_mode = 'INCLUDE' or datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.last_seen_date, l.lead_date)) < cfg.lookback_days ) ) ranked where ranked.rn = 1 order by ranked.priority desc, ranked.lead_id asc limit 1000

insert ignore into dy_rpa_outreach_task( task_no, viewer_id, lead_id, shop_config_id, sec_uid, profile_url, status, priority, attempt_count, max_attempts, create_time, update_time ) select replace(uuid(), '-', ''), ranked.viewer_id, ranked.lead_id, ranked.shop_config_id, ranked.sec_uid, concat('https://www.douyin.com/user/', ranked.sec_uid), 'pending', ranked.priority, 0, 5, sysdate(), sysdate() from ( select l.viewer_id, l.lead_id, rs.shop_config_id, v.sec_uid, (ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) * 1000 + least(ifnull(v.comment_count, 0), 100) * 10) as priority, row_number() over (partition by l.viewer_id, rs.shop_config_id order by l.lead_date desc, l.lead_id desc) as rn from dy_viewer_daily_lead l inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = l.viewer_id inner join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = l.room_key inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and sc.status = '0' where l.viewer_id in #{viewerId} and v.sec_uid is not null and trim(v.sec_uid) != '' and ifnull(v.status, 'new') = 'new' and not exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = l.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id) ) and not exists ( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = l.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) ) ranked where ranked.rn = 1

select b.batch_id as batchId, b.batch_no as batchNo, b.shop_config_id as shopConfigId, b.worker_id as workerId, b.lease_token as leaseToken, b.status, b.task_count as taskCount, b.completed_count as completedCount, b.lease_expire_time as leaseExpiresAt, b.create_time as createTime, sc.shop_code as shopCode, sc.shop_name as shopName, sc.douyin_account_code as douyinAccountCode, sc.douyin_shop_name as douyinShopName, sc.message_template as messageTemplate, sc.daily_limit as dailyLimit , sc.message_templates_json as messageTemplatesJson, sc.hourly_limit as hourlyLimit, sc.burst_size as burstSize, sc.rest_minutes as restMinutes, sc.allowed_start_time as allowedStartTime, sc.allowed_end_time as allowedEndTime, sc.refund_cooldown_days as refundCooldownDays, sc.cancelled_cooldown_days as cancelledCooldownDays, sc.pause_on_captcha as pauseOnCaptcha, sc.max_consecutive_failures as maxConsecutiveFailures from dy_rpa_outreach_batch b inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = b.shop_config_id where b.batch_no = #{batchNo} limit 1

select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_no as taskNo, t.lead_id as leadId, t.viewer_id as viewerId, t.sec_uid as secUid, t.profile_url as profileUrl, t.status, t.priority, t.attempt_count as attemptCount, v.nickname, ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) as hasComment, ifnull(v.comment_count, 0) as commentCount, v.last_comment_content as lastCommentContent, ( select left(group_concat(c.content order by c.captured_at desc separator ' | '), 1000) from dy_viewer_comment c where c.lead_id = t.lead_id and c.content is not null and trim(c.content) != '' ) as recentCommentContent, ( select ifnull(sum(s.estimated_stay_seconds), 0) from dy_live_viewer_stay s where s.viewer_id = t.viewer_id and s.room_key = l.room_key and s.last_seen_at >= l.lead_date and s.first_seen_at < date_add(l.lead_date, interval 1 day) ) as estimatedStaySeconds, l.lead_date as leadDate, coalesce(nullif(r.room_name, ''), nullif(l.live_room_name, ''), l.room_key) as liveRoomName from dy_rpa_outreach_task t inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = t.viewer_id inner join dy_viewer_daily_lead l on l.lead_id = t.lead_id left join dy_live_room r on r.room_key = l.room_key where t.batch_no = #{batchNo} and t.status = 'leased' order by t.priority desc, t.task_id asc

then 1 else 0 end as blacklisted, case when exists( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) then 1 else 0 end as marketingSuppressed, case when rs.shop_config_id is null or sc.shop_config_id is null then '直播间未指定可用店铺' when cfg.enabled = 0 then '系统跟进已暂停' when ifnull(v.status, 'new') != 'new' then '用户状态不允许联系' when vr.tracking_mode = 'EXCLUDE' then '已暂停联系' when exists( select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id) ) then '已加入不再联系名单' when exists( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) then '已购买或售后保护中' when t.task_id is not null then '已经进入执行队列' when datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.last_seen_date, l.lead_date)) >= cfg.lookback_days and vr.tracking_mode != 'INCLUDE' then '已超过跟进时间范围' else null end as ineligibleReason, case when rs.shop_config_id is null or sc.shop_config_id is null then 0 when cfg.enabled = 0 or ifnull(v.status, 'new') != 'new' then 0 when vr.tracking_mode = 'EXCLUDE' then 0 when exists( select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id) ) then 0 when exists( select 1 from dy_rpa_marketing_suppression ms where ms.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and ms.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and (ms.suppression_until is null or ms.suppression_until > sysdate() or ms.manual_review_required = 1) ) then 0 when t.task_id is not null then 0 when vr.tracking_mode = 'INCLUDE' then 1 when datediff(curdate(), ifnull(v.last_seen_date, l.lead_date)) < cfg.lookback_days then 1 else 0 end as eligible, row_number() over ( partition by v.viewer_id, coalesce(cast(rs.shop_config_id as char), concat('ROOM:', l.room_key)) order by l.lead_date desc, l.lead_id desc ) as rowNumber from dy_viewer_daily_lead l inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = l.viewer_id left join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = l.room_key left join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and sc.status = '0' inner join dy_rpa_tracking_config cfg on cfg.config_id = 1 left join dy_rpa_viewer_rule vr on vr.viewer_id = v.viewer_id left join dy_rpa_outreach_task t on t.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and t.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id left join dy_live_room r on r.room_key = l.room_key where l.lead_date >= #{beginDate} and l.lead_date <= #{endDate} and rs.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}
and (v.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or v.sec_uid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) = #{hasComment} ) candidate where candidate.rowNumber = 1
and candidate.eligible = 1 and candidate.trackingMode = 'AUTO' and candidate.trackingMode = 'INCLUDE' and candidate.trackingMode = 'EXCLUDE'
order by candidate.eligible desc, candidate.hasComment desc, candidate.commentCount desc, candidate.leadId desc

select t.task_id as taskId, t.task_no as taskNo, t.viewer_id as viewerId, t.lead_id as leadId, t.profile_url as profileUrl, t.status as taskStatus, t.priority, t.attempt_count as attemptCount, t.max_attempts as maxAttempts, t.batch_no as batchNo, t.worker_id as workerId, t.lease_expire_time as leaseExpireTime, t.outcome, t.douyin_no as douyinNo, t.order_no as orderNo, t.order_status as orderStatus, t.order_time as orderTime, t.refund_status as refundStatus, t.refund_reason as refundReason, t.refund_time as refundTime, t.refund_amount as refundAmount, t.marketing_suppressed as marketingSuppressed, t.message_template_key as messageTemplateKey, t.message_template_name as messageTemplateName, t.followed, t.messaged, t.result_code as resultCode, t.error_message as errorMessage, t.first_claim_time as firstClaimTime, t.completed_time as completedTime, t.create_time as createTime, t.update_time as updateTime, coalesce(nullif(v.nickname, ''), l.nickname, '未知观众') as nickname, ifnull(v.has_comment, 0) as hasComment, ifnull(v.comment_count, 0) as commentCount, v.last_comment_content as lastCommentContent, l.lead_date as leadDate, sc.shop_config_id as shopConfigId, sc.shop_code as shopCode, sc.shop_name as shopName, coalesce(nullif(r.room_name, ''), nullif(l.live_room_name, ''), l.room_key) as liveRoomName from dy_rpa_outreach_task t inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = t.viewer_id inner join dy_viewer_daily_lead l on l.lead_id = t.lead_id inner join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = t.shop_config_id left join dy_live_room r on r.room_key = l.room_key where 1 = 1
and t.status = 'pending' and t.status = 'leased' and t.status not in ('pending', 'leased')
and t.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}
and (v.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.douyin_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.task_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and t.status = #{taskStatus} and date(ifnull(t.completed_time, t.update_time)) between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} order by t.task_id desc

select ( select count(distinct concat(l.viewer_id, ':', coalesce(cast(rs.shop_config_id as char), concat('ROOM:', l.room_key)))) from dy_viewer_daily_lead l inner join dy_viewer v on v.viewer_id = l.viewer_id left join dy_rpa_room_shop rs on rs.room_key = l.room_key left join dy_rpa_shop_config sc on sc.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id and sc.status = '0' left join dy_rpa_viewer_rule vr on vr.viewer_id = v.viewer_id left join dy_rpa_outreach_task t on t.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and t.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id where l.lead_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} and ifnull(v.status, 'new') = 'new' and t.task_id is null and ifnull(vr.tracking_mode, 'AUTO') != 'EXCLUDE' and not exists(select 1 from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist bl where bl.viewer_id = v.viewer_id and (bl.scope_key = 'GLOBAL' or bl.shop_config_id = rs.shop_config_id)) and rs.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId} ) as candidateCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.status = 'pending' and t.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}) as pendingCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.status = 'leased' and t.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}) as leasedCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.status = 'pending' and t.attempt_count > 0 and t.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}) as retryCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.status = 'failed' and t.shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}) as failedCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.completed_time >= curdate() and t.status in ('ordered', 'contacted', 'skipped')) as todayCompletedCount, (select count(1) from dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist) as blacklistCount

insert into dy_rpa_viewer_blacklist( viewer_id, scope_key, shop_config_id, reason, remark, operator_id, operator_name, create_time, update_time ) values
(#{viewerId}, #{scopeKey}, #{shopConfigId}, #{reason}, nullif(#{remark}, ''), #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, sysdate(), sysdate())
on duplicate key update reason = values(reason), remark = values(remark), operator_id = values(operator_id), operator_name = values(operator_name), update_time = sysdate()
mapper.update: update dy_rpa_outreach_task set status = 'cancelled', result_code = 'BLACKLISTED', error_message = '用户已加入黑名单', lease_token = null, worker_id = null, lease_expire_time = null, completed_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where viewer_id in #{viewerId} and status in ('pending', 'leased') and shop_config_id = #{shopConfigId}

update dy_rpa_outreach_batch b set b.status = 'cancelled', b.active_shop_key = null, b.completed_time = sysdate(), b.update_time = sysdate() where b.status = 'leased' and not exists(select 1 from dy_rpa_outreach_task t where t.batch_no = b.batch_no and t.status = 'leased')
